decision.reason: [ev-f44aa981165a] is only a table-of-contents entry. The section context [ev-dd988a5ed5c3] tells operators to upgrade to provider versions that support both namespaced and cluster-scoped managed resources, and says existing cluster-scoped MRs "continue working unchanged" on those versions. Neither says what happens if providers are not upgraded: nothing fails, is rejected or stops working. The proposal's own statement admits this, so "migration-required" claims mandatory work the evidence doesn't support. To decide, we need upstream text that says whether pre-v2 providers still work with Crossplane v2 core.
